name: work-queue
description: A shared work queue in one JSON file: a pane grouped by what each item waits on (your call, PRs, other items, events), a status line count, /queue commands, and a queue tool Claude uses to add, start and finish items

file.title: Queue file
file.description: The queue's JSON file, absolute or relative to the working directory

markdown.title: Markdown copy
markdown.description: Where to write a readable Markdown copy after each change; empty for none

checkPrs.title: Check PRs with gh
checkPrs.description: Clear a 'waits on PR' once gh reports the PR merged

archive.title: Archive file
archive.description: Where items go once they have ended a while ago: one JSON item per line. Empty for the queue file's name with .archive.jsonl

archiveAfterDays.title: Archive after days
archiveAfterDays.description: Move done and dropped items to the archive this many days after they end; 0 keeps them in the queue
